original.target_description: Original p. 371 (PDF p. 3) contains Survey 1 aggregate bias comparison, Survey 2 aggregate bias comparison, individual-item comparisons, and the bias-versus-shortcomings contrast. No study/sample or outcome qualifier uniquely selects a test.

replication.target_description: Replication p. 1401 (PDF p. 10), section 3.1, reports aggregate bias tests for Study 1a, Study 2, and Study 3. Supplied Study 1 Survey 2 names the replicated original design, not a unique replication sample. The identical assigned descriptions do not distinguish the three samples.
